name: Marquee
whenToUse: A strip of customer logos, short quotes or partner names on a landing page — “trusted by”.

whenNotToUse.text: Content people need to read or act on

anatomy.description: the items twice, moving by half its width; `duration` seconds per loop.
stops and resumes the strip (`pauseButton`, on by default).

do.caption: Short, uniform items; calm speed; pause button kept.

dont.caption: Long sentences racing past with no way to stop them.
dont.example: Read our full terms before the offer ends tonight

a11y: WCAG 2.2.2: the strip pauses on hover and keyboard focus, and the pause button stops it for good.
The second copy of the items is aria-hidden and inert: screen readers and Tab meet each item once.
prefers-reduced-motion: no movement — the items wrap into rows.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full loop; longer is calmer.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the strip out at both edges.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items (a CSS length, e.g. "2.5rem").

props.name: pauseButton
props.description: Show the pause / play button (default). Turn off only for a purely decorative strip.
